Reprojects a raster into another coordinate reference system, optionally with a new cell size.

**Toolbox folder:** Raster Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Raster, Reprojection, CRS<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.RasterReprojector`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inRaster` | raster file |  |  | The raster to reproject. |
| `pXres` | Double |  |  | The optional cell size in x of the output. |
| `pYres` | Double |  |  | The optional cell size in y of the output. |
| `pCode` | CRS code |  |  | The code of the target coordinate reference system, as EPSG:32632. |
| `pInterpolation` | String |  | `nearest neightbour` | The interpolation of the new cells: nearest neighbour keeps the original values, as needed for classes and codes; bilinear and bicubic smooth them. Allowed values: `nearest neightbour`, `bilinear`, `bicubic`. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outRaster` | output file |  | The reprojected raster. |
